# Feishu command reference

[English](feishu-commands.md) | [简体中文](feishu-commands.zh-CN.md)

Commands below come from the same registry and translations as Feishu's context help. In groups, address commands to the bot. The current mode, Agent capabilities and authorization still determine whether an action can run. Chinese command phrases remain literal command tokens in both languages.

Bot-wide singleton mode uses `/amux` for conversation management and rejects topic-style `/run`, `/bind` and `/stop`. `/compact`, `/clear` and `/skill` require a supporting Agent. There is no supported `/schedule` or `/sched` topic command; use Agent tools or the operator CLI.

## Private chat

| Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `/amux` | Show assistant status, settings and system maintenance |
| `/help` | Show private chat help |
| `/run <profile> -n <name>` | Create a task session in this message topic |
| `/bind <target/session>` | Bind this message topic to an existing session |
| `/status` | Show the bound session status |
| `/restart` | Restart the bound session |
| `/interrupt` | Stop the current response and keep the task |
| `/stop` | End the current task |
| `/skill` | Choose a skill loaded by the current session |
| `/compact` | Compact context and retain a summary |
| `/clear` | Keep the session binding and start a fresh conversation |

## Group chat

| Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `/amux` | Show access settings for this group |
| `/help` | Show group chat help |
| `开启协作模式` | Owner only: let group members mention the assistant to start tasks |
| `关闭协作模式` | Owner only: restrict access to the owner |
| `开启群值守` | Owner only: confirm to handle new topics in this group automatically |
| `关闭群值守` | Owner only: confirm to remove this group from watch |
| `/run <profile> -n <name>` | Create a task session explicitly |
| `/bind <target/session>` | Bind to an existing session |

## New topic

| Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `/amux` | Show how to start a task |
| `/help` | Show how to start a task |
| `开启群值守` | Owner only: confirm to handle new topics in this group automatically |
| `关闭群值守` | Owner only: confirm to remove this group from watch |
| `/run <profile> -n <name>` | Create a task session explicitly |
| `/bind <target/session>` | Bind to an existing session |

## Active bound topic

| Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `/amux` | Show the current task status |
| `/help` | Show available actions for the current task |
| `/interrupt` | Stop the current response and keep the task |
| `/stop` | End the current task |
| `/skill` | Choose a skill loaded by the current Codex session |
| `/compact` | Compact the current context and retain a summary |
| `/clear` | Clear the current context and start a new conversation |
| `/status` | Show the current session status |
| `/restart` | Restart the current session |
| `/bind <target/session>` | Bind to another session |
